title: United Mine Workers of America Power PAC spent $318.1K supporting Alison Lundergan Grimes for the Senate (KY)
summary: United Mine Workers of America Power PAC reported $318,073.00 supporting Alison Lundergan Grimes for the Senate (KY): TV ADS AIRTIME - KENTUCKY, paid to ANN SMITH COMMUNICATIONS. Seen from 2014-10-13; reported 2015-03-27, as filed with the FEC.
